headline: Ruble and tenge fall, euro rises: exchange rates for November 20
summary: The euro rose above 96 soms after updating its annual low, while the Russian rouble and Kazakh tenge moved lower. The Chinese yuan rate was also quoted in the daily exchange-rate report.
why: Currency moves against the Kyrgyz som affect import costs, remittance values and the purchasing power of foreign-currency earnings in Kyrgyzstan.
original_headline: Рубль и тенге ушли в минус, евро подорожал: курс валют на 20 ноября
